verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents bulk actions, such as bulk-sending, bulk-updating, or bulk-deleting many invoices or records at once, in the UI or via bulk API endpoints. Recurring invoices and scheduled sending automate repeated one-item creation on a schedule, which is not a bulk operation across many items. The statement that the API can do everything the web client does is a developer building block with no bulk capability documented, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
